designs.name: Le dernier souffle de la forêt
designs.subject: A majestic white wolf in three-quarter portrait guarding a tiny radiant emerald seedling; sweeping ancient cedar branches form an incomplete circular crest around the wolf. Left branches lush emerald, right branches charred dark charcoal, with new gold leaves re-emerging. Quiet fierce protective gaze, ivory fur, emerald and subtle vermilion accents. Original environmental fantasy anime artwork conveying protecting nature and renewal, inspired thematically by Princess Mononoke but an independent composition with no recognizable movie character or logo.

designs.name: Au-delà des distances
designs.subject: Two tiny original anime young adult silhouettes standing on opposite curved distant hilltops at twilight; a single vivid red thread flows from their hands and forms an elegant infinity arc through a luminous double comet and cobalt violet star field. An isolated graceful vertical emblem with crisp outer edges; luminous ivory highlights and coral-red thread. Evoke connection, memory and hope across distance, inspired thematically by Your Name. Original independent characters, no copied movie frame or logo.

designs.name: Une seconde chance
designs.subject: A poetic original anime illustration of two expressive delicately drawn hands reaching toward each other, fingertips nearly touching, above concentric teal water ripples. A small golden repaired crack in the central ripple symbolizes reconciliation, cherry blossom petals and a small ivory paper crane rise upward. Elegant asymmetrical flowing emblem, muted teal ivory dusty pink with a few gold accents. Convey empathy, communication and forgiveness, inspired thematically by A Silent Voice without copying any movie frame or character. Anatomically correct hands, five fingers each.
